Goodtech ASA: Mandatory notification of trade by primary insider

 2026-11-02 08:00:00

Margrethe Hauge, CEO and primary insider in Goodtech ASA, has on 30 October 2026 purchased 10,000 shares in Goodtech ASA at an average price of NOK 14.40 per share. 

Following the transaction, Margrethe Hauge holds 380,343 shares in Goodtech ASA. 

Please see the attached form for further details. 

This information has been submitted pursuant to the Securities Trading Act § 5-12 and MAR. The information was submitted for publication, through the agency of the contact persons set out above, at 2026-11-02 08:00 CET.
